full_prompt_en: A square, aged sepia motion-study image arranges several successive positions of a running man across a plain studio ground. The repeated figure moves from the left toward the right, each appearance slightly farther forward and in a different stage of the stride. At the far left, the body is darker and more compressed, with limbs gathered as if preparing to push off. Through the middle, pale and dark exposures overlap: arms swing, a bent knee advances, and the torso leans forward. Near the right edge, the figure becomes darker again, one leg driving forward while the other extends behind. The runner wears a dark jacket and trousers over a light shirt, and the head remains level enough that the row of faces makes a clear horizontal rhythm. Several positions blend into one another rather than occupying tidy separate boxes, so the movement reads as one continuous action translated into a dense band of bodies. The upper third is mostly bare warm paper, with faint vertical scratches and a few thin registration-like lines crossing the picture. Under the feet, a narrow dark baseline and several parallel horizontal rules run across the lower frame, providing a measured ground for the forward motion. The background is flat and without scenery, props, or a visible audience. Old print wear, grain, uneven density, and slightly blurred limbs remain visible throughout. The interest lies in the visible intervals of an ordinary physical action: repetition, overlap, and the changing geometry of bent arms and legs make time legible in a single still image.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、旧化的棕褐色运动研究图像，把一名奔跑男子的几个连续位置排在平淡的影棚地面上。重复的人形由左向右移动，每次出现都更靠前，跨步阶段也不同。最左边身体较暗且更收缩，四肢聚起，像正准备蹬出。画面中部，浅色与深色曝光相互叠压：手臂摆动、屈膝向前、上身俯倾。接近右缘，形体再度变深，一条腿向前驱动，另一条伸向后方。奔跑者穿深色外套与长裤，里边是浅色衬衫，头部高度相对稳定，因此一排面孔构成清晰水平节奏。几个位置互相融合，而非整齐地占据独立方格，所以运动像一场连续动作被压成密集的人形带。上方约三分之一主要是空白暖色纸面，带隐约竖向刮痕和穿过图像的几根细定位线。脚下，一道窄深基线和数条平行横纹横贯下部，为向前运动提供可测量的地面。背景平坦，没有风景、道具或观众。旧印刷磨损、颗粒、不均匀密度和略微模糊的肢体始终可见。兴趣在于平常动作的可见间隔：重复、叠压和不断改变的曲臂屈腿几何，让时间在一张静止图像里变得可读。
style_prompt_en: Antique photographic motion study in warm sepia or monochrome, built from repeated positions across a plain field. Keep the camera fixed and the ground line steady while one form changes pose in evenly advancing increments. Some exposures can overlap or remain translucent, creating a clear rhythm of time rather than a set of unrelated figures. A wide empty band above the action emphasizes the horizontal progression below. Fine grain, faded paper tone, scratches, and faint ruled or registration lines establish an aged analytical print surface. Contrast varies slightly between successive positions, with blurred extremities retaining the sensation of speed. The visual language is observational and diagrammatic, but it also finds elegance in repeated silhouettes and the measured geometry of movement.
style_prompt_zh: 古早摄影运动研究采用暖棕褐或黑白色，在平坦背景上叠出形体的连续位置。相机固定、地面基线稳定，一种形体在等距前进中改变姿势。某些曝光可互相遮叠或半透明，让时间形成清晰节奏，而非一组无关人物。动作上方留宽阔空带，强调下部水平推进。细颗粒、褪色纸调、刮痕和隐约量线或定位线建立旧分析图版表面。连续位置之间反差略有变化，模糊的肢端保留速度感。视觉语言具有观察性和图解性，同时从重复剪影与可测量的运动几何中找到优雅。
theme_en: A sepia motion-study image layers successive positions of a man running from left to right
theme_zh: 一幅棕褐色运动研究图像叠出一名男子由左向右奔跑的连续位置
name: Eadweard Muybridge
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
